import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/kv-seed')
from kvdump import dump_server, digest
old = dump_server(6379)
new = dump_server(6380)
print('old keys:', {db: len(d) for db, d in old.items()})
print('new keys:', {db: len(d) for db, d in new.items()})
print('old digest:', digest(old))
print('new digest:', digest(new))
print('MATCH' if digest(old) == digest(new) else 'MISMATCH')
# Detailed per-key comparison including exact PTTL
def flat(d):
    f = {}
    for db, kd in d.items():
        for k, (t, v, p) in kd.items():
            f[(db, k)] = (t, v, p)
    return f
fo, fn = flat(old), flat(new)
missing = set(fo) - set(fn); extra = set(fn) - set(fo)
diffval = [k for k in set(fo) & set(fn) if fo[k][0] != fn[k][0] or fo[k][1] != fn[k][1]]
ttlbig = [k for k in set(fo) & set(fn) if fo[k][2] >= 0 and fn[k][2] >= 0 and abs(fo[k][2] - fn[k][2]) > 5000 or (fo[k][2] >= 0) != (fn[k][2] >= 0)]
print('missing on new:', len(missing), 'extra on new:', len(extra))
print('value/type diffs:', len(diffval), diffval[:5])
print('ttl diffs >5s or expiring-flag mismatch:', len(ttlbig), ttlbig[:5])
"

python3 -c "
import redis
ro = redis.Redis(port=6379, socket_timeout=30)
rn = redis.Redis(port=6380, socket_timeout=30)
tot_g = tot_c = tot_p = 0
for k in ro.scan_iter():
    if ro.type(k) != b'stream': continue
    go = ro.xinfo_groups(k); gn = rn.xinfo_groups(k)
    if not go and not gn: continue
    print('==', k.decode())
    for a, b in zip(go, gn):
        assert a['name'] == b['name'], (a, b)
        po = ro.xpending_range(k, a['name'], min='-', max='+', count=100000)
        pn = rn.xpending_range(k, a['name'], min='-', max='+', count=100000)
        co = sorted((c['name'].decode(), c['pending']) for c in ro.xinfo_consumers(k, a['name']))
        cn = sorted((c['name'].decode(), c['pending']) for c in rn.xinfo_consumers(k, b['name']))
        ok = (a['last-delivered-id'] == b['last-delivered-id'] and a['pending'] == b['pending'] and co == cn and [(p['message_id'], p['consumer']) for p in po] == [(p['message_id'], p['consumer']) for p in pn])
        tot_g += 1; tot_c += len(co); tot_p += len(po)
        print('   group %-12s last-delivered=%s pending=%s consumers=%s pel=%s -> %s' % (a['name'].decode(), a['last-delivered-id'].decode(), a['pending'], len(co), len(po), 'OK' if ok else 'MISMATCH'))
print('TOTAL groups:', tot_g, 'consumers:', tot_c, 'pending entries:', tot_p)
"
